_comment: Containment guard for local-model agent runs. Pass with --settings so it stays OUTSIDE the folder the agent can edit. Denies this project's notes about the tasks, the published TTT-Discover solutions, and the auto-memory directory. Web tools are denied because they do not work behind a local model anyway: WebSearch is an Anthropic server-side tool and WebFetch's safety check calls api.anthropic.com directly, ignoring ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL -- denying them stops the agent burning turns discovering that.
